name: Cast To
description: Attempts to interpret an object reference as a more specific type. If the object is actually that type, the Cast Succeeded pin fires with a typed reference; if not, the Cast Failed pin fires.

inputs.name: Object
inputs.description: The object reference to attempt to cast. Connect any object reference (e.g. an Actor reference) that may or may not be the target type.

outputs.name: Cast Succeeded
outputs.description: Fires if the object is the requested type. Continue with the typed reference only after this pin.

outputs.name: Cast Failed
outputs.description: Fires if the object is not the requested type. Handle this path to log, fallback, or abort.

outputs.name: As [TargetType]
outputs.description: The object reference typed as the cast target. Valid only on the Cast Succeeded path. The exact type name depends on the chosen cast target.
